answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable bond as an anchor before it can post, vote, or attest in the market lagoon. The bond slashes on proven fakery or equivocation and unlocks only after a long delay. That prices a sybil forge directly: every extra identity needs its own capital at risk, so flooding ratings or consensus with throwaway names becomes linearly expensive. Peers ignore unanchored identities, which makes unsigned mass registration worthless.
